sentences.pt: Na segunda-feira, Ana acordou e ligou a televisão.
sentences.en: On Monday, Ana woke up and turned on the television.

sentences.pt: A notícia principal do jornal era sobre uma greve dos motoristas de ônibus.
sentences.en: The main story on the news was about a bus drivers' strike.

sentences.pt: Os motoristas queriam um salário melhor e mais segurança.
sentences.en: The drivers wanted a better salary and more safety.

sentences.pt: "Hoje não vai ter ônibus na cidade", disse a jornalista.
sentences.en: "Today there won't be any buses in the city," said the journalist.

sentences.pt: Ana trabalha num escritório no centro do Recife, longe de casa.
sentences.en: Ana works in an office in downtown Recife, far from home.

sentences.pt: Ela não tem carro, e o metrô estava muito cheio.
sentences.en: She doesn't have a car, and the subway was very crowded.

sentences.pt: Então ela decidiu ir de bicicleta.
sentences.en: So she decided to go by bike.

sentences.pt: Na avenida principal, o trânsito estava horrível.
sentences.en: On the main avenue, the traffic was awful.

sentences.pt: Ela viu muitas pessoas andando a pé e alguns táxis.
sentences.en: She saw many people walking and a few taxis.

sentences.pt: Perto da prefeitura, tinha uma manifestação dos motoristas.
sentences.en: Near city hall, there was a protest by the drivers.

sentences.pt: Eles estavam calmos e falavam sobre a vida difícil deles.
sentences.en: They were calm and talked about their hard life.

sentences.pt: Um motorista explicou: "O preço de tudo aumentou, mas o nosso salário não."
sentences.en: A driver explained: "The price of everything went up, but our salary didn't."

sentences.pt: Ana concordou com ele.
sentences.en: Ana agreed with him.

sentences.pt: Ela chegou ao escritório quarenta minutos atrasada.
sentences.en: She got to the office forty minutes late.

sentences.pt: A chefe também estava atrasada, por causa do engarrafamento.
sentences.en: The boss was also late, because of the traffic jam.

sentences.pt: À tarde, todos no escritório estavam lendo notícias na internet.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, everyone in the office was reading news on the internet.

sentences.pt: Às cinco horas, o prefeito anunciou que o salário dos motoristas ia aumentar.
sentences.en: At five o'clock, the mayor announced that the drivers' salary was going to go up.

sentences.pt: A greve acabou, e os ônibus voltaram à noite.
sentences.en: The strike ended, and the buses came back in the evening.

sentences.pt: Ana voltou para casa de ônibus, cansada mas aliviada.
sentences.en: Ana went back home by bus, tired but relieved.

questions.q: Como Ana foi para o trabalho?
questions.qEn: How did Ana go to work?

questions.q: Quem anunciou a notícia às cinco horas?
questions.qEn: Who announced the news at five o'clock?

sentences.pt: Domingo foi dia de eleição no Brasil.
sentences.en: Sunday was election day in Brazil.

sentences.pt: Carla tem dezesseis anos e ia votar pela primeira vez.
sentences.en: Carla is sixteen years old and was going to vote for the first time.

sentences.pt: No Brasil, os jovens podem votar a partir dos dezesseis anos.
sentences.en: In Brazil, young people can vote from the age of sixteen.

sentences.pt: Durante a semana, ela leu muitas informações na internet e nas redes sociais.
sentences.en: During the week, she read a lot of information on the internet and on social networks.

sentences.pt: Ela também viu o jornal na televisão todas as noites.
sentences.en: She also watched the news on television every night.

sentences.pt: Carla e o pai, Paulo, conversaram muito sobre os problemas do país.
sentences.en: Carla and her father, Paulo, talked a lot about the country's problems.

sentences.pt: Para ela, os problemas mais importantes são a pobreza e o meio ambiente.
sentences.en: For her, the most important problems are poverty and the environment.

sentences.pt: O pai acha que a economia e o desemprego são mais importantes.
sentences.en: Her father thinks the economy and unemployment are more important.

sentences.pt: Eles discordam de vez em quando, mas sempre conversam com calma.
sentences.en: They disagree from time to time, but they always talk calmly.

sentences.pt: No domingo de manhã, os dois foram a uma escola perto de casa.
sentences.en: On Sunday morning, the two of them went to a school near home.

sentences.pt: A escola estava cheia de gente.
sentences.en: The school was full of people.

sentences.pt: Carla estava um pouco nervosa e muito animada.
sentences.en: Carla was a little nervous and very excited.

sentences.pt: Quando chegou a vez dela, ela entrou na sala e votou.
sentences.en: When her turn came, she went into the room and voted.

sentences.pt: Foi rápido e simples.
sentences.en: It was quick and simple.

sentences.pt: Depois, ela tirou uma foto em frente da escola.
sentences.en: Afterwards, she took a photo in front of the school.

sentences.pt: Ela colocou a foto na rede social com a mensagem: "Meu primeiro voto!"
sentences.en: She put the photo on social media with the message: "My first vote!"

sentences.pt: À noite, a família viu as notícias da eleição na televisão.
sentences.en: In the evening, the family watched the election news on television.

sentences.pt: O novo presidente falou sobre paz e trabalho para todos.
sentences.en: The new president talked about peace and jobs for everyone.

sentences.pt: Carla não sabia se o novo governo ia ser bom.
sentences.en: Carla didn't know if the new government was going to be good.

sentences.pt: Mas ela estava orgulhosa: agora ela também é uma cidadã.
sentences.en: But she was proud: now she is a citizen too.

questions.q: Para Carla, quais problemas são mais importantes?
questions.qEn: For Carla, which problems are most important?
options: A pobreza e o meio ambiente
